clue.text: Writers' enclosures

definitions.meaning: people who write, or the instruments they write with: ballpoints, quills
fenced areas for keeping animals, such as sheep folds

explanation.surface: Something the authors have penned in, or kept in their pens.
explanation.definitionFit: Ink instruments are writers in one sense, and folds for livestock are enclosures in the other.

clue.text: A cut must be properly organised

definitions.meaning: neat, tidy and in good order

explanation.surface: Some reduction must be carried out in an orderly way.
explanation.definitionFit: A light haircut is one sense; neat and in good order is the adjective sense.

clue.text: Come down for a season

explanation.surface: An invitation to drop by for a period of the year.
explanation.definitionFit: To drop is one sense; autumn, in American usage, is the other.

clue.text: The bloomer of a fellow in a muddle

parts.note: a gent is a man or fellow

indicators.note: being in a muddle means these two short words are jumbled up

explanation.surface: A man's blunder, made while he is confused.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' suggests a blunder, but here it is a plant that blooms. 'muddle' rearranges IN A to IAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A blue-flowered alpine plant is a flowering thing, playfully called a bloomer.

clue.text: Thomas's one is fat!

parts.note: in the children's stories about Thomas the Tank Engine, the railway boss is known by his girth

explanation.surface: A remark that someone named Thomas has a portly companion.
explanation.walkthrough: The Fat Controller is the railway manager in the Thomas the Tank Engine books and TV series.
explanation.definitionFit: The rotund railway manager in the Thomas stories is known as the Fat one of his job title.

clue.text: Writing about a member maybe meant preparing to do battle again

parts.note: RE heads a business letter to mean 'concerning'
an arm is a limb, a member of the body

indicators.note: maybe suggests the word meant could be arranged some other way

explanation.surface: A letter about someone in the club apparently meant to signal a return to war.
explanation.definitionFit: Arming once more is getting ready for renewed war.

clue.text: Being likely to have some hesitation in making offering

indicators.note: the first word is to have the hesitation sound held within it

parts.note: tending means inclined or likely
er is a sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Someone apt to hesitate when making a bid.
explanation.definitionFit: To tender is to offer formally, as in a bid for a contract.

clue.text: Medico on a satellite

parts.note: MO is the medical officer, a doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor travelling on a space satellite.
explanation.definitionFit: Earth's natural satellite is the one that orbits us each month.

clue.text: Me'squite unable to better himself, poor beggar

definitions.text: Me'squite unable to better himself, poor beggar

parts.words: Me'squite unable to better himself, poor beggar
parts.note: read as a confession of being unable to improve, it splits into the word for repair and a phrase for being unable

explanation.surface: A self-pitying lament from someone who cannot get on in life.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer splits as MEND I CAN'T, 'better' meaning improve or repair. The clue as printed appears to have an OCR join, 'Me'squite' for 'Me's quite'.
explanation.definitionFit: A mendicant is one who lives by begging alms.

clue.text: A ninny is easy understand-to a point

parts.note: simple means easy to understand
N is north, a compass point

explanation.surface: A fool is someone who can be understood only up to a point.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed clue seems to have lost a 'to' in 'easy to understand'.
explanation.definitionFit: A fool or dunce is a ninny.

clue.text: A vegetable, in shape an almost perfect sphere

indicators.note: in shows the letters sit inside the words shape an

explanation.surface: A green vegetable, shaped as a nearly perfect ball.
explanation.walkthrough: The rest of the clue describes the round vegetable, adding to the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A small round green seed eaten as food is a vegetable.

clue.text: Mark's letter

definitions.meaning: a sign or brief written comment

explanation.surface: A letter belonging to someone called Mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief written jotting is a mark or comment, and a short missive is a letter.

clue.text: Figure on sales pitch for pop

parts.note: D is 500 as a Roman numeral
an ad is an advertisement

explanation.surface: A number written on a sales stand for a soft drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Pop is an informal word for father.

clue.text: Parade people backing the French rogue in a hole

indicators.note: in shows the article and rogue go inside the hole

parts.note: a cave is a hollow or hole

indicators.note: backing means the French article is read in reverse

parts.note: la is French for the
a cad is a dishonourable man

explanation.surface: Marchers supporting a French scoundrel who is in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns LA into AL; AL and CAD go into CAVE.
explanation.definitionFit: A cavalcade is a procession, a formal parade.

clue.text: Offspring of a Californian prospector is fruit

definitions.meaning: in the folk song, the girl is the daughter of a miner, a forty-niner

explanation.surface: A gold miner's child turns out to be fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: The American folk song 'Oh My Darling' tells of a miner's daughter in the California gold rush.
explanation.definitionFit: The miner's daughter in the song shares her name with a small orange citrus fruit.

clue.text: Bewildering relatives-so changeable

indicators.note: bewildering means the word relatives is thrown into confusion

explanation.surface: Confusing family members are so unpredictable.
explanation.definitionFit: Adaptable and able to turn to many things is versatile, so variable or changeable.

clue.text: Painting beaches on a headland

parts.note: to beach a boat is to bring it to land
a cape is a point of land jutting into the sea

explanation.surface: A picture of coastline near a promontory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beaches' is a verb: one lands a boat by beaching it.
explanation.definitionFit: A painting of scenery is a picture of the countryside.

clue.text: A club's pressing need

definitions.meaning: a golf club with a metal head
what is needed for pressing clothes

explanation.surface: A society's urgent requirement.
explanation.definitionFit: A metal-headed golf club is one sense; the appliance for pressing clothes is the other.

clue.text: Rotten ingrate doing some damage

indicators.note: rotten means the word ingrate is spoilt into a new order

explanation.surface: A nasty ungrateful person causing harm.
explanation.definitionFit: Ripping something causes damage to it.

clue.text: Half a dozen agree as necessary

parts.note: six is VI in Roman numerals
to tally is to correspond or agree

explanation.surface: Six people agree that something is needed.
explanation.definitionFit: Done in an essential way, vitally means in a needful manner.

clue.text: Newly-formed army set to gain control

indicators.note: newly formed means the letters of army set are put together in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A freshly raised army is ready to seize power.
explanation.definitionFit: Command or dominance over something is mastery.

clue.text: Venture to get in front of a Greek character

indicators.note: the wager is placed before the single letter

parts.note: to bet is to venture or wager money

explanation.surface: A gamble to get ahead of a person from Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: The second letter of the Greek alphabet is a character in that script.

clue.text: Several start chuckling-it's killing!

indicators.note: start means the first letter of the word several is taken

parts.note: chuckling is a form of laughter

explanation.surface: A group begins giggling at something hilarious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'killing' looks like slang for very funny, but it is the definition: slaughter.
explanation.definitionFit: Slaughter is mass killing.

clue.text: Edge around to draw attention

definitions.meaning: to surround or enclose, as a border does
a small cough to attract notice

explanation.surface: A border is put round to make people notice.
explanation.definitionFit: To border or enclose is one sense; the throat-clearing sound used to catch notice is the other.

clue.text: Some of the apprentices will make nervous complaint

indicators.note: some of means only part of the word apprentices is used

explanation.surface: A few trainees will develop an anxious ailment.
explanation.definitionFit: An involuntary twitch is a nervous affliction.

clue.text: A case of pins &needles

parts.note: read not as the tingling sensation but as a container for sewing pins and needles

explanation.surface: An example of the tingling feeling in a limb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pins and needles' is the tingling of a numb limb; here 'case' is a box.
explanation.definitionFit: An etui is a small ornamental case for sewing needles.

clue.text: Constituents toast them no more

indicators.note: constituents suggests the letters of toast them are the components of a new phrase

explanation.surface: Voters drink a toast to their representatives no longer.
explanation.definitionFit: Not exceeding a limit, the phrase means nothing beyond that amount.

clue.text: Jealousy of a minister, nothing less

indicators.note: less shows the zero is taken away

parts.note: an envoy is a diplomatic minister
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A diplomat's jealousy, nothing short of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Envy is resentful longing for what another has, close to jealousy.

clue.text: Put out at finding a quarter inside out

indicators.note: inside shows the compass letter goes into the last word

parts.note: S is south, a quarter of the compass

explanation.surface: Being annoyed at discovering a coin turned inside out.
explanation.definitionFit: To expel or eject someone is to oust them.

clue.text: Move to get the drink about right

indicators.note: about shows the drink goes around the letter for right

parts.note: a tot is a small measure of spirits

explanation.surface: Advice to go and get a drink at just the right time.
explanation.definitionFit: To trot is to move at a brisk running pace.

clue.text: At one time a person would carry a note

indicators.note: would carry means the person holds the note within

parts.note: one means a person, as in 'one should'
C is a musical note

explanation.surface: In the past someone would carry a message.
explanation.definitionFit: Formerly, on a past occasion, is the meaning.

clue.text: A means of seeing the Continent without a passport

definitions.text: A means of seeing the Continent without a passport

parts.words: A means of seeing the Continent without a passport
parts.note: the European song contest is watched on television, viewing mainland Europe from the sofa

explanation.surface: Travel advice on visiting mainland Europe with no papers.
explanation.walkthrough: The Continent is Europe as seen from Britain; the answer is European television.
explanation.definitionFit: The European television network lets viewers watch Europe from home.
